subject: VMWARE_ESXI_REFERENCE_GOVERNANCE
statement: The repository mechanically traces every VMware experiment from Tech Story to representative VMware run and hash-bound VMware evidence, derives non-closing acceptance associations from requiredTechStories, and keeps the QEMU Correctable AER root-sequence positive control in a typed non-closing control reference with a distinct subject.
limitations: Historical pyVmomi task identifiers and initiating actors are not uniformly retained.
Historical VMware runs do not all conform to contracts/vmware-experiment-result.schema.json; VMW-AER-COR-001 has profile-specific canonical pairs but their raw runs remain external artifacts.
Representative run IDs do not imply that every legacy case has a canonical result.

The 2026-07-26 QEMU AER root-sequence run is a separately typed reference positive control and is not a VMware run or VMware evidence; ESXi repeat/multiple/W1C/re-arm, notification/service attribution, guest writes, lifecycle recovery, and physical health remain unverified.
Derived acceptance links remain non-closing associations; this index is traceability evidence, not case completion evidence.
This reference-governance result cannot close a Qman product case, risk, implementation milestone, qualification profile, or release gate.
